facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy held a public sector stakeholder validation workshop in Nairobi on 5 February 2026 on the draft National Data Governance Policy, with representatives of the private sector, academia and civil society in the room, as part of a consultation process the Ministry says included surveys, town hall meetings, key informant interviews and regional engagements.
